entries.title: II Samuel 16:1
segments: ¶And when David was a little past the summit, behold, Ziba, Mephibosheth's servant, met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred [loaves] of bread, and a hundred raisin-cakes, and a hundred cakes of summer fruits, and a flask of wine.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:2
segments: And the king said to Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses are for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruits for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as are faint in the wilderness may drink.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:3
segments: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said to the king, Behold, he abides at Jerusalem; for he said, To-day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:4
segments: And the king said to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained to Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly bow myself: may I find favour in thy sight, my lord, O king.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:5
segments: ¶And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, there came out from thence a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed,

entries.title: II Samuel 16:6
segments: and cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David; and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:7
segments: And thus said Shimei as he cursed: Away, away, thou man of blood and man of Belial!

entries.title: II Samuel 16:8
segments: Jehovah has returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and Jehovah has given the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son; and behold, thou art [taken] in thine own evil, for thou art a man of blood.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:9
segments: And Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:10
segments: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, for Jehovah has said to him, Curse David! Who shall then say, Why dost thou so?

entries.title: II Samuel 16:11
segments: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, who came forth of my bowels, seeks my life: how much more now a Benjaminite? let him alone and let him curse; for Jehovah has bidden him.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:12
segments: It may be that Jehovah will look on mine affliction, and that Jehovah will requite me good for my being cursed this day.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:13
segments: And David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:14
segments: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:15
segments: ¶Now Absalom, and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:16
segments: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, came to Absalom, that Hushai said to Absalom, Long live the king! Long live the king!

entries.title: II Samuel 16:17
segments: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why didst thou not go with thy friend?

entries.title: II Samuel 16:18
segments: And Hushai said to Absalom, No; but whom Jehovah, and this people, and all the men of Israel choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:19
segments: And again, whom should I serve? should it not be in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:20
segments: And Absalom said to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:21
segments: And Ahithophel said to Absalom, Go in to thy father's concubines, whom he has left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art become odious with thy father; and the hands of all that are with thee shall be strong.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:22
segments: So they spread a tent for Absalom upon the roof; and Absalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

entries.title: II Samuel 16:23
segments: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had inquired of the word of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
